about: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited is an environmental technology company providing engineering solutions and proprietary technologies in wastewater treatment (WWT), wastewater recycling & reuse (WRR), and solid waste treatment (SWT). Incorporated in 2005, it holds an over 80% market share in sequencing batch reactor (SBR) technology in India through its proprietary C-Tech process. The company operates across 23 states and five union territories in India and manages municipal solid waste facilities in Goa.

objects.purpose: Prepayment of outstanding borrowings of Company and subsidiary Vasudha Waste Treatment

concentration.note: Top 10 customers contributed 64.44% and top customer contributed 14.34% of revenue in FY26. 92.35% of FY26 revenue was directly or indirectly dependent on government entities/tenders.

litigation_note: Contingent liability includes a customs notice of ₹0.02 crore. Subsidiary SFC Umwelttechnik GmbH is involved in material litigations in Portugal and Austria.
strengths: Market leader in sequencing batch reactor wastewater treatment in India with over 80% market share.
Proprietary C-Tech technology facilitating cumulative wastewater treatment capacity of over 17,144 MLD across 705 installations.
Integrated operations with in-house manufacturing, automation capabilities, and strategic partnerships reducing dependence on third parties.
Market leadership in solid waste treatment with proprietary OREX technology and long-term operating concession plants in Goa.
Strong recurring revenue with repeat customers accounting for 91.98% of operations revenue in Fiscal 2026.
Robust order book of ₹1,570.07 crore as of June 30, 2026 spanning WWT, WRR, and SWT segments.
Exclusive distribution partnership with DuPont for advanced membranes and wastewater recycling and reuse technologies in India.
Consistent financial profile with operating EBITDA margins around 29.3% and PAT margin of 19.94% in FY26.

risks.title: Heavy dependence on government entities and contracts
risks.detail: Revenue directly or indirectly attributable to government entities or tenders accounted for 92.35% of FY26 and 92.40% of FY25 revenue.

risks.title: High customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers accounted for 64.44% and top 5 accounted for 47.10% of revenue from operations in Fiscal 2026 without long-term contracts.

risks.title: History of negative operating cash flows
risks.detail: The company reported negative cash flow from operating activities of ₹25.80 crore in FY26 and ₹11.69 crore in FY24.

risks.title: Revenue concentration in WWT and SWT segments
risks.detail: Wastewater and solid waste treatment segments together accounted for 84.98% and 84.34% of consolidated revenue in FY26 and FY25, respectively.

risks.title: High working capital requirements
risks.detail: Working capital represented 65.19% of FY26 revenue, with cash conversion cycle extending to 242 days in FY26 and 411 days in Q1 FY27.

risks.title: Increasing trade receivables collection period
risks.detail: Trade receivable collection days expanded from 197 days in FY24 to 262 days in FY25, 282 days in FY26, and 443 days in Q1 FY27.

risks.title: Unsecured loans extended to subsidiaries
risks.detail: Subsidiaries including Hindustan Waste Treatment and Vasudha Waste Treatment have availed unsecured loans from the company that can be recalled anytime.

risks.title: Litigation risks at subsidiaries
risks.detail: Subsidiaries SFC Umwelttechnik GmbH, HWTPL, and VWTPL are involved in legal proceedings, including disputes before courts in Portugal and Austria.

notes: Financial data derived from Restated Consolidated Financial Information. Figures for three-month stub periods ended June 30, 2025 and June 30, 2026 have been excluded from the financial arrays.
